headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 5, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs, while Michael McGreevy pitched 4.1 innings with five strikeouts. The Washington Nationals suffered a 6-3 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies, marking their defeat in the matchup. Derek Hill led the Nationals' offense with a home run and four RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Washington Nationals due to a left oblique strain. The Athletics have also placed Jeffrey Springs on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, due to right hip discomfort, and Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, due to a strained right thumb.

There have been several trades and roster movements across the league. The Athletics acquired RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling 4-3 Win Over Brewers**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close matchup, securing a 4-3 victory. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on a single hit in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall to Cubs in 5-10 Thrashing**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers, securing a 5-10 victory. Michael Busch led the Dodgers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, marking their defeat in the matchup. Impact players for the Orioles included Nolan Schanuel, Josh Lowe, Wade Meckler, and Tyler O'Neill, while Grayson Rodriguez and Cade Povich stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 6-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea leading the way on the mound. Impact hitters for the Mets included A.J. Ewing, Bo Bichette, Carson Benge, Luis Torrens, and Jo Adell.

top_news.title: **Nationals' James Wood Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right fielder James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson in a trade. Johnson joins the Athletics after being dealt from the Philadelphia Phillies.
